patches.title: No Sink Without Object
patches.principle: Only go to the sink if you are holding the object that needs cleaning.
patches.when_to_apply: When you need to clean an object.

patches.title: Avoid Circular Placement
patches.principle: Do not place an object back onto its original surface if it still needs cleaning or placement.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that requires cleaning or final placement.

patches.title: Skip Examine on Clean Target
patches.principle: Do not examine an object that must be cleaned; proceed directly to the sink.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have just picked up an object that needs cleaning.
